items.title: Spain orders NordVPN and ProtonVPN to block LaLiga stream piracy
items.description: A Spanish court has granted precautionary measures against NordVPN and ProtonVPN, ordering the two popular VPN providers to block 16 websites that facilitate piracy of football matches. [...]

items.title: Supply Chain Attack Embeds Malware in Android Devices
items.description: Keenadu downloads payloads that hijack browser searches, commit ad fraud, and execute other actions without user knowledge.

items.title: Poland Energy Survives Attack on Wind, Solar Infrastructure
items.description: Russia-aligned groups are probable culprits behind the wiper attacks against renewable energy farms, a manufacturer, and a heating and power plant.

items.title: Flaws in popular VSCode extensions expose developers to attacks
items.description: Vulnerabilities with high to critical severity ratings affecting popular Visual Studio Code (VSCode) extensions collectively downloaded more than 128 million times could be exploited to steal local files and execute code remotely. [...]

items.title: RMM Abuse Explodes as Hackers Ditch Malware
items.description: It's the path of lesser resistance, as remote monitoring and management (RMM) software offers stealth, persistence, and operational efficiency.

items.title: ClickFix Attacks Abuses DNS Lookup Command to Deliver ModeloRAT
items.description: ClickFix campaigns have adapted to the latest defenses with a new technique to trick users into infecting their own machines with malware.
